name: Nicco Reggente
abstract: The therapeutic potential of peak emotional states has emerged as a compelling frontier in affective neuroscience, particularly through the systematic investigation of aesthetic chills—those profound, micro-mystical, psychophysiological responses characterized by goosebumps and psychogenic shivers, accompanied by self-transcendent experiences.
